svg.title: Wiecon Time Tracker
svg.desc: A punch file is uploaded in the app and imported into attendance.db; the screen, the PDF reports and the AI assistant all read it back through one query layer, the assistant's agents only through read-only tools. a punch file: punch file → main.py index() → _process_attendance_rows → InteractWithDatabase → attendance.db. a question: main.py index() → supervisor → specialists → query tools → InteractWithDatabase → attendance.db.
